verdicts.reason: dark-1280 dump confirms badge background oklch(0.222 0.01 268) on a card of oklch(0.232 0.02 272). Two parts of the finding fail. The CSS (index-Da_oL6iI.css) already gives .badge a 1px border var(--color-border), which is oklch(26.1% 0.012 271) in dark per tokens.json, so the suggested fix of adding a border is already present. dark-1280.png also shows a faint but discernible pill, so the badge does not read as bare text. What holds is that the pill is low-contrast (fill and border within about 0.03 L of the card); that is a mild polish issue and matches the reference's 4%/8% white alpha choice noted in tokens.json. severity_suggestion: NOTE

375.json holds the p.text-sm entry with the quoted text; 375.png shows the line wrapping as 'ホンダファイナンスデータの最終更新：2026年10月' / '24日 6:00', so the date is split mid-value. At 1280 the line fits on one line. Genuine rendering flaw, cosmetic, WARNING is fair.

The bundle source (index-DKXolRs7.js, component Xb) renders the header button with className header-icon-btn and aria-label `${e.name}のメニュー`; the visible 'C' is a span with aria-hidden=true. The accessible name is therefore the user's name plus 'のメニュー' (e.g. 'TEST STAFF Cのメニュー'), which states what the button opens. The dump's text 'C' is only the visible text content. A visible initial-only avatar is a common convention; no tooltip exists, but the missing-name claim is disconfirmed.
